fuente.titulo: United on two wheels: ‘On a bike, there is no difference. We're equal'

titular: Cycling champions join Pope Leo in bike donation
bajada: Vatican event gives bicycles to vulnerable youth, says sport erases social barriers
caption: Former and current cycling champions gathered at the Vatican to meet Pope Leo XIV and take part in a ceremony donating bicycles to young people in vulnerable situations. Organizers said the event reflects how cycling can break down social barriers. Source: Vatican News, Nov 23, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A row of donated bicycles lined up in a sunlit Vatican courtyard, with a figure resembling a pope greeting cyclists in the upper right, left and center open
